description: Follows Vera Rubin’s observational astronomy, including how spectra and galaxy rotation curves reveal the distribution of gravitating mass. Distinguishes evidence for unseen mass from identification of its physical nature, and connects the measurements to collaboration, instrumentation and the barriers faced by women in astronomy.
